name: Groq
guide: Create a Groq account, stay on its free plan, and create an API key. Choose a text model available under your plan. Groq is distinct from xAI Grok.

name: Google Gemini / Gemma
guide: Create an AI Studio key for your Google project. Check the pricing table and project quota for the exact model. Free-tier data policies differ from paid-tier policies.

name: OpenRouter
guide: Create an OpenRouter key or use Connect account in Settings after saving. Select a :free model or openrouter/free. The latter selects a free model upstream; its choice can vary.

name: Cloudflare Workers AI
guide: Open Workers AI in your dashboard. Copy your account ID and create a token scoped to Workers AI. Replace ACCOUNT_ID in the endpoint. Check that your model is eligible for the daily free allocation.

name: Cohere
guide: Create an evaluation key, not a production key. Select an available text model. Evaluation limits and production-use terms apply.

name: Cerebras
guide: Check trial eligibility before adding a verified payment method. Current documentation describes expiring trial credits, not a permanent free tier. Create an API key and copy an available text model ID from the console.

name: NVIDIA API Catalog
guide: Join the developer program, select a hosted text model and choose Get API Key. Review trial terms and available credits. Copy the model ID from its API example; production access may require a separate service.

name: Mistral
guide: Check whether Experiment access is currently offered to your account. Do not assume the free chat website grants API access. Create a key and copy a model ID eligible for your plan. Do not activate paid billing unless intended.

name: Ollama (local)
guide: Install Ollama and download a text model suitable for your RAM. Start its server, then enter the installed model name. Docker uses host.docker.internal; native CombineLLM uses localhost. The server must be reachable from the backend. Hardware and electricity are your costs.
